date.description: Focused date (drives which range is visible).

today.description: Locale/timezone-aware "today" date — useful for highlighting current day.

visibleRange.description: Raw start/end of the currently visible range.

visibleRangeText.description: Localized text for the visible range — prefer this over formatting by hand.

visibleDays.description: Enumerated dates from visibleRange.start to visibleRange.end, inclusive.

columns.description: The columns to render — one per visible day, or one per day × resource when grouping by resource.

getTimelineState.description: Rows and slots for the timeline view.

getAllDaySegments.description: All-day events as continuous bars across a row of days, one per event.

getAllDayOverflow.description: Bars `maxAllDayRows` hid, counted per day, for rendering a "+N more" affordance.

resources.description: The resources passed in, or an empty array.

formatDuration.description: Human-friendly duration between two dates, e.g. "1h 30m" / "45m".

formatWeekDay.description: Locale/timezone-aware weekday label for a specific date.

hourRange.description: Hour range shown in day/week time grids (honors dayStartHour/dayEndHour).

events.description: All events (recurring instances expanded against the visible range).

visibleEvents.description: Events whose range overlaps `visibleRange` — the set you actually render.

getAgendaGroups.description: Visible events grouped by day and sorted by start.

isDragging.description: Whether the user is currently dragging an event.

isSelectingSlot.description: Whether the user is currently selecting a slot.

isResizing.description: Whether the user is currently resizing an event.

dragState.description: State of the active drag or resize — null when idle.

selectedSlot.description: Slot the user selected (clicked or drag-selected).

focusedDate.description: Day cell that currently has keyboard focus in a month/year grid.

setFocusedDate.description: Imperatively move keyboard focus to a specific date.

clearFocusedDate.description: Drop keyboard focus from the month grid.

setDate.description: Move the visible range to contain this date.

goToToday.description: Jump the visible range to today.

goToPrevious.description: Go back by one view-sized step.

clearSelectedSlot.description: Dismiss the selected slot highlight (e.g. when a create dialog closes).

getEventState.description: Interaction state for an event — dragging, focused, conflicting, and so on.

getDayColumnState.description: Day-level flags for the given column — use to conditionally render custom UI (drop-target hint, day-specific styling) without reconstructing the comparisons from `dragState` / `selectedSlot`.

getEventPosition.description: Numeric position within a day column — use for custom layouts.

getTimePercent.description: 0..1 fraction of the visible day range corresponding to the given date's time-of-day.

getMonthName.description: Localized full month name for the given date, e.g. "April".

getViewText.description: Display text for a view, e.g. "Week". Render it as the view item's children.

getMonthNames.description: Twelve localized month names in order.

getMonthGrid.description: Weeks × days covering the month that contains `date`, padded to full weeks.

getEventById.description: O(1) event lookup by id (reads from the current events list).

getEventsForDay.description: Events touching a day, multi-day ones included.

getEventsForColumn.description: Events for a column — scoped to its resource when grouping by resource.

getEventsForRow.description: Events for a timeline lane — scoped to its resource when the lane has one.

hasConflict.description: Whether the event has a conflict.

getEventEl.description: The DOM element rendered by `getEventProps` for the given event id.

getSelectedSlotEl.description: The DOM element rendered by `getSelectedSlotProps` for the active `selectedSlot` day.

getRootState.description: Returns the state of the root

onViewChange.description: Fires when the view mode changes.

onDateChange.description: Fires when the focused date changes.

events.description: Flat list of events (expand recurring events before passing)

dayStartHour.description: First hour shown in day/week time grid.

dayEndHour.description: Last hour shown in day/week time grid.

workWeekDays.description: Days of week to show in work-week mode, 0=Sun…6=Sat.

workWeekOnly.description: When true, `api.visibleDays` in week view is filtered down to `workWeekDays`.

resources.description: Resources (people, rooms, equipment) to schedule against.

onSlotSelect.description: Fires when a user selects an empty slot — either by single click or by drag-release.

onEventReceive.description: Fires when an item dragged from outside the scheduler is dropped on a slot.

dataTransferFormat.description: `dataTransfer` format read on an external drop.

onSlotDoubleClick.description: Fires on double-click of an empty slot — the conventional "create event" fast-path that bypasses slot selection (selectedSlot is not set).

onDayActivate.description: Fires when a day cell is activated via click, Enter, or Space while focused.

onEventClick.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

onEventDrop.description: Fires when an event is dropped.

onEventResize.description: Fires when an event is resized.

canDragEvent.description: Return false to prevent dragging an event.

canResizeEvent.description: Return false to prevent resizing an event.

canDropEvent.description: Decides whether a drag or resize may commit at its current position.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale used for week-start day and date formatting.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone driving `today` and every formatter.

startOfWeek.description: Override the first day of the week (0=Sun…6=Sat).

showWeekNumbers.description: Show week numbers in week view.

showCurrentTime.description: Show a line at the current time in day/week views.

maxAllDayRows.description: Levels of all-day bars to show before the rest collapse into per-day counts. Unbounded when unset.

maxRecurrenceInstances.description: Upper bound on expanded recurring instances per visible range.

expandRecurrence.description: Called on each recurring event to expand instances within the visible range.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

ColumnHeader.data-today: Present when the date represents today
ColumnHeader.data-weekend: Present when is a weekend day

TimelineSlot.data-today: Present when the date represents today

DayColumn.data-today: Present when the date represents today
DayColumn.data-weekend: Present when is a weekend day

DayCell.data-today: Present when the date represents today
DayCell.data-weekend: Present when is a weekend day

Event.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state
